findings.claim: The error includes information that lets a developer reconstruct the curl command, which is unnecessary since the developer can already build the curl command by looking at the error.
The constructed object is missing a createdAt field even though the relay task status entity defines one, so the returned data may not match the expected entity shape.
The code still references Gelato even though after this PR nothing related to Gelato should remain, and other locations in the codebase should be checked for the same leftover reference.
The corresponding configuration value should also be updated in docker-compose.yml to stay consistent with this schema change.
